name: Current-source single-thread memory-capacity and persistent-ID verification
scope: Engineering only; no cohort efficacy, validation selection or test release
reason: The completed uninterrupted/fresh-resume gate covered at most 16384 spatial keys and cached single-object reads. Verify the remaining native 28672-key capacity and persistent multi-object ownership.
runtime: CPU FP32, torch threads=1, deterministic algorithms; unchanged SAM2.1 Hiera-Tiny checkpoint and existing adapters

polypgen.frames: First labelled prompt plus next eight manifest frames, fixed before launch
polypgen.gradient_check: Reuse existing autoregressive update helper for two updates per arm on the final frame, with the previous native predicted bank. This tests the full 28672-key backward path without retaining nine-frame BPTT graphs.
polypgen.training_targets: Only final-frame GT in the original TRAIN sequences, used by loss after forward

davis.prompt: Indexed mask on frame0 only; no later annotations opened
davis.isolation: For each trained arm compare joint raw per-object bank/predictions against reversed prompt insertion and against each ID run in isolation. Require native non-overlap coupling disabled, as in the pinned default.
davis.not_efficacy: No J/F/Dice evaluation or cohort inference

adapter_source: Frozen reference final states from key_adapter_optimization_validity_v1/process_resume_check_v1; independently audited uninterrupted/resume equality
must_pass: Zero-adapter logits and all five stored memory fields match native hashes exactly
Each object/frame reaches layers0,1,2,3; IDs and target frames explicitly observed
Frames7 and8 use exactly 28672 spatial keys; pointers remain separate and unchanged
Memory values and spatial/temporal key position alignment remain native
Nonzero adapter remains finite with unchanged SAM2 weights
Full-capacity backward gives finite nonzero gradients in all four layers
Joint/reversed/isolated per-object raw outputs match exactly for both trained arms
Source, pretrained checkpoint, adapter checkpoints, input files and runtime are hash-bound
stop: Stop at first integrity failure, retain artifacts, no tolerance relaxation. This gate never authorizes efficacy or reopens the failed pilot's test split.
reuse: Existing SAM2 prepare and native propagation
Existing four-layer trace checks and nested tensor digests
